correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed the S2-invariant Lambrechts-Stanley model J^s from R=Q[a,b]/(a^3,b^3) with de=a^2+ab+b^2 and relation (a-b)e=0. Verified (a-b)Delta=a^3-b^3=0 so d is well defined and d^2=0; quotient odd dimensions are 1 in degrees 3,5,7 and 0 above (rank computation); differentials d(e)=p+q, d(s1e)=2r, d(qe)=w are all nonzero, giving H^0=H^2=H^4=Q and H^3=H^5=H^6=H^7=H^8=0. Verified s1^2=p+2q is independent of p+q (so [s1]^2!=0) and s1^3=3r=d((3/2)s1e) (so [s1]^3=0), hence H*=Q[t]/(t^3), |t|=2. Verified L=Lambda(x_2,y_5), dy=x^3 is Sullivan minimal with H(L)=Q[x]/(x^3), and both legs phi(x)=s1, phi(y)=(3/2)s1e with phi(dy)=3r=d(phi(y)) and psi(x)=t, psi(y)=0 with psi(dy)=0 are CDGA quasi-isomorphisms inducing isomorphisms Q[x]/(x^3)->Q[t]/(t^3). Ran inputs/artifacts/verify_formality.py successfully. Target branch (ii) is completely proved.

originality.rationale: Fused literature search (SerpBase/Serpent Top 10-20, OpenAlex and Crossref Top 15 x3 queries, no partial failure) plus full-text inspection of the nearest prior work Lambrechts-Stanley AIF 2004 and Idrissi LS-model thesis/blog shows no prior record of the headline: rational formality of unordered C_2(CP^2), its cohomology Q[t]/(t^3), or its minimal model Lambda(x_2,y_5), dy=x^3 with the stated zigzag. The nearest formality corollary (LS Cor 6.1) explicitly requires H1=H2=0 and therefore excludes CP^2; Kriz/Totaro give only a CDGA model with nontrivial differential, not formality; Idrissi/Campos-Willwacher prove the LS model is a real model but do no formality analysis for this pair. No synonymous encoding, dual, database table, or broader classification was found to imply or exhaustively cover the claim; see decisive_checks.

value.rationale: TARGET branch (ii) decides the admitted two-sided formality question for the natural object C_2(CP^2) over Q: unordered two-point configuration of CP^2, a recognized test case in rational homotopy of configuration spaces. The result is a rigorously established exact invariant (cohomology ring Q[t]/(t^3), Sullivan minimal model, explicit formality zigzag, uniform Massey vanishing) that was motivated before computation, was not known or mechanically implied (the applicable prior formality corollary excludes CP^2 by its H2 hypothesis), and a future researcher can reasonably need verbatim as a model for computations. It is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration, and meets STANDARD eligibility for an exact invariant of a natural object without requiring a new general theorem.

No formality determination or minimal model for C_2(CP^2).

broader_coverage.evidence: Fetched Idrissi thesis Thm 1/Cor 116-117: G_A(k) is a real model for simply connected closed M and real homotopy type depends only on M; fetched LS AIF Cor 6.1: F(M,2) formal only if M formal with H1=H2=0; LS Prop 6.6: non-formal M implies non-formal F(M,k). None exhibits the quasi-isomorphism zigzag J^s <- Lambda(x_2,y_5) -> (Q[t]/(t^3),0), the minimal-model differential dy=x^3, or Massey vanishing for this pair; the Kriz differential is exactly what must be killed by the new coboundary (3/2)s1e.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The prior model is the starting input, not the conclusion: passing from the LS/Kriz CDGA with nontrivial differential to formality requires computing H*, identifying the relation t^3=0 as a coboundary, and constructing two verified quasi-isomorphisms. That argument is not present in Kriz/Totaro/LS/Idrissi and is not a mechanical rewriting, certificate, or repackaging of a known stronger fact.
